cases.sentence: Я увидел на ___ еще одно великое знамение.
cases.translation: I saw another great sign in the sky.
cases.explain: The preposition на (in) governing location uses the prepositional case.

cases.sentence: Я видел нечто похожее на стеклянное ___.
cases.translation: I saw something like a sea of glass.
cases.explain: The preposition на followed by adjective describing an object takes the accusative case.

cases.sentence: На ___ стояли те, кто вышел победителем в борьбе со зверем.
cases.translation: On the sea stood those who overcame in battle with the beast.
cases.explain: The verb стоять (to stand) with the preposition на indicating location on top of takes the dative case.

cases.translation: They held harps of God in their hands.
cases.explain: The preposition в (in) governing location uses the prepositional case.

cases.sentence: Они были одеты в чистую и блестящую льняную ___.
cases.translation: They were clothed in pure, bright linen garments.
cases.explain: The preposition в (in/into) indicating what someone is dressed in takes the accusative case.

cases.sentence: По груди каждый был опоясан золотым ___.
cases.translation: Each was girded about the chest with a golden sash.
cases.explain: The verb быть with the past participle опоясан (girded) describes the manner/means, using instrumental case.

cases.sentence: Из ___ вышли семь ангелов с семью бедствиями.
cases.translation: Seven angels came out of the temple with seven plagues.
cases.explain: The preposition из (out of) always governs the genitive case.

cases.sentence: Храм наполнился ___ от славы и силы Божией.
cases.translation: The temple was filled with smoke from the glory and power of God.
cases.explain: The verb наполниться (to be filled) takes the instrumental case for what fills something.

reading.ru: Я увидел на небе еще одно великое и удивительное знамение.
reading.question: What did the speaker see in the sky?
reading.explain: The text says Я увидел на небе еще одно великое и удивительное знамение (I saw another great and marvelous sign in the sky).

reading.ru: Я видел нечто похожее на стеклянное море, смешанное с огнем.
reading.question: What was the sea-like object mixed with?
reading.explain: The text describes it as стеклянное море, смешанное с огнем (a sea of glass mixed with fire).

reading.ru: На море стояли те, кто вышел победителем в борьбе со зверем, его изображением и с числом его имени.
reading.question: Who stood on the sea of glass?
options: Those who overcame the beast, his image, and the number of his name
reading.correct: Those who overcame the beast, his image, and the number of his name
reading.explain: The text says те, кто вышел победителем в борьбе со зверем (those who overcame in battle with the beast).

reading.ru: Они держали в руках Божьи арфы и пели песнь Моисея, слуги Божьего, и песнь Ягненка.
reading.question: What did those on the sea of glass sing?
options: The song of Moses and the song of the Lamb
reading.correct: The song of Moses and the song of the Lamb
reading.explain: The text explicitly states они пели песнь Моисея и песнь Ягненка (they sang the song of Moses and the song of the Lamb).

reading.ru: После этого я увидел, что на небе открыт храм.
reading.question: What did the speaker see opened in heaven?
reading.explain: The text says на небе открыт храм (the temple in heaven was opened).

reading.ru: Храм наполнился дымом от славы и силы Божией, и никто уже не мог войти в храм.
reading.question: Why could no one enter the temple after it was filled with smoke?
options: Because it was filled with smoke from God's glory and power
Because seven plagues were being sent
reading.correct: Because it was filled with smoke from God's glory and power
reading.explain: The text explains Храм наполнился дымом от славы и силы Божией, и никто уже не мог войти (the temple was filled with smoke from the glory and power of God, and no one could enter).
